title: Claimfast Legal
description: Personal-injury lawyers with a litigation drone that wires you a settlement before you finish falling.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-cash
lines.text: Slip and our drone wires you a settlement before you hit the floor! Claimfast Legal... if you bend, somebody pays!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Drone may sue your reflection. <p:0> Clients develop a litigious limp. <p:0> Settlements paid in teeth. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
